scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:studio && rm -rf apps/ios/Matry/Matry/Web && mkdir -p apps/ios/Matry/Matry/Web && cp apps/studio/index.html apps/ios/Matry/Matry/Web/index.html && cp -R apps/studio/styles apps/ios/Matry/Matry/Web/styles && cp -R apps/studio/dist apps/ios/Matry/Matry/Web/dist
scripts.ios:build:sim: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Matry/Matry.xcodeproj -scheme Matry -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath apps/ios/Matry/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false packages/project packages/generation packages/providers apps/studio
